name: Acquired Palace original through recipient-owned native carrier

condition.code:
local p=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER')
local source=p and CityManager.GetCityAt(p.Work.X,p.Work.Y)
local target=p and CityManager.GetCityAt(p.Recovery.X,p.Recovery.Y)
return source and source:GetOwner()==2 and source:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(p.Work.Building,p.Work.Slot)==2
 and target and target:GetOwner()==1 and target:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(p.Recovery.Building,p.Recovery.Slot)==-1

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local target=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER')).Recovery
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(target.X,target.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==1 and city:GetID()==target.City,'recipient noncapital carrier changed')
local blockers,owners,seen={},{},{}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do local p=Players[owner];if p then for _,unit in p:GetUnits():Members() do
 if unit:GetX()==target.X and unit:GetY()==target.Y then blockers[#blockers+1]={Owner=owner,ID=unit:GetID(),Type=GameInfo.Units[unit:GetType()].UnitType,Damage=unit:GetDamage(),Moves=unit:GetMovesRemaining()} end
end end end
for _,entry in ipairs(blockers) do
 local unit=assert(UnitManager.GetUnit(entry.Owner,entry.ID));local placed=false
 for x=target.X-6,target.X+6 do for y=target.Y-6,target.Y+6 do
  local plot=Map.GetPlot(x,y);local on=plot and Map.GetUnitsAt(plot)
  if not placed and plot and plot:GetOwner()==entry.Owner and not plot:IsWater()
    and not plot:IsImpassable() and (x~=target.X or y~=target.Y)
    and (not on or on:GetCount()==0) then
   UnitManager.PlaceUnit(unit,x,y)
   if unit:GetX()==x and unit:GetY()==y then
    if unit:GetDamage()~=entry.Damage then unit:SetDamage(entry.Damage) end
    if unit:GetMovesRemaining()~=entry.Moves then unit:ChangeMovesRemaining(entry.Moves-unit:GetMovesRemaining()) end
    assert(unit:GetID()==entry.ID and unit:GetOwner()==entry.Owner and unit:GetDamage()==entry.Damage
     and unit:GetMovesRemaining()==entry.Moves,'center blocker state changed')
    placed=true
   end
  end
 end end
 assert(placed,'no empty owned plot for target carrier center blocker')
end
local works=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
assert(#works==1 and works[1].Owner==2,'fixture changed original Palace work')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_TARGET_CLEAR] moved='..#blockers..' city='..city:GetID())
return 'recipient noncapital carrier center prepared without deleting units'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local saved=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local work=assert(A.NativeWorkLocations(saved.WorkIndex)[1])
assert(saved.WorkIndex==2 and #A.NativeWorkLocations(2)==1 and work.Owner==2
 and work.BuildingType=='BUILDING_PALACE' and work.CreatedByPlayer~=2
 and work.X==saved.Work.X and work.Y==saved.Work.Y,
 'acquired Palace original is not in its exact saved source')
local target=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER')).Recovery
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(target.X,target.Y))
local capital=assert(Players[1]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity())
assert(city:GetOwner()==1 and city:GetID()==target.City and city:GetID()~=capital:GetID()
 and Players[1]:GetCities():GetCount()>=2
 and A.CityAssets(city).BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[target.Slot]==-1,
 'noncapital human Temple carrier is unavailable')
local ids={['leader:2']=true}
for id in pairs(A.GetRoster(2)) do ids[id]=true end
for _,unit in Players[2]:GetUnits():Members() do
 local person=unit:GetProperty(A.Rules.PERSON_KEY)
 local snap=A.SnapshotUnit(unit)
 local id=person and person.ID or snap.Kind=='UNIT' and ('unit:2:'..unit:GetID())
   or ('native-person:2:'..unit:GetID())
 ids[id]=true
end
for _,item in ipairs(A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(2)) do ids['native-work:'..item.Index]=true end
local plan={ID='native-acquired-palace-route',From=2,To=1,Mode='MERGER',
 EntryConditionsMet=true,RelationsResolved=true}
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FLOW_TEST_MODE',1)
for id in pairs(ids) do F.DebugSetRoll(plan.ID,id,'P1_ESCAPE',9999) end
local flow=F.Begin(plan)
assert(flow.Phase=='CHOICE' and flow.Phase1Complete,'new acquired-Palace Flow did not reach CHOICE')
local original
for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries) do
 if entry.ID=='native-work:2' then original=entry end
 if not entry.EscapeOutcome then
  F.DebugSetRoll(plan.ID,entry.ID,'P3_SUCCESS',0)
  local action=entry.ID=='native-work:2' and 'TRANSFER' or entry.AllowedActions[1]
  if action=='RETURN' then action=assert(entry.AllowedActions[2]) end
  assert(action,'Flow has no valid disposition for '..entry.ID)
  F.Select(1,plan.ID,entry.ID,action)
 end
end
assert(original and not original.EscapeOutcome,'original index escaped before acquired-Palace transfer')
flow=F.Resolve(1,plan.ID)
assert(flow.Phase=='APPLYING' or flow.Phase=='RESULT',
 'acquired-Palace Flow failed before its saved native intent: '..tostring(flow.Error))
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_ROUTE',{
 ID=plan.ID,WorkIndex=2,Source=A.Rules.Copy(work),Target=A.Rules.Copy(target),
 DonorCities=Players[2]:GetCities():GetCount(),Rolls=A.Rules.Copy(original.Rolls)})
print('[JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_ROUTE_BEGIN] phase='..flow.Phase..' source='..work.CityID..' target='..target.City)
return 'acquired Palace original transfer chosen with frozen Flow rolls'

condition.code:
local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption
local tx=a and a.GetState().Transactions['native-acquired-palace-route']
for _,work in ipairs(tx and tx.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if work.Source.Index==2 then return work.Carrier and (work.Carrier.Phase=='BORROW' or work.Carrier.Phase=='MOVE' or work.Carrier.Phase=='RETURN' or work.Carrier.Phase=='PROVED') end
end
return false

local F=ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow
local A=ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption
local flow=F and F.Get('native-acquired-palace-route')
local tx=A and A.GetState().Transactions['native-acquired-palace-route']
local expected=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_ROUTE')
local city=expected and CityManager.GetCityAt(expected.Target.X,expected.Target.Y)
return flow and flow.Phase=='RESULT' and tx and tx.Status=='COMPLETE'
 and city and city:GetOwner()==1 and city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(expected.Target.Building,expected.Target.Slot)==2

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local expected=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_ROUTE'))
local flow=assert(F.Get(expected.ID))
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[expected.ID])
assert(flow.Phase=='RESULT' and tx.Status=='COMPLETE',
 'acquired Palace product route incomplete: '..tostring(flow.Error or tx.Error))
local snap
for _,item in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do if item.Source.Index==2 then snap=item end end
assert(snap and snap.NativeRoute=='CARRIER' and snap.Carrier and snap.Carrier.Route=='TO_OWNER'
 and snap.Carrier.Phase=='PROVED' and snap.PhysicalMoved and not snap.DealSubmitted,
 'acquired Palace work used Core deal or unproved carrier')
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==1 and found[1].X==expected.Target.X
 and found[1].Y==expected.Target.Y and found[1].Building==expected.Target.Building
 and found[1].Slot==expected.Target.Slot and found[1].CityID==snap.TargetSlot.City,
 'original index missed exact human Temple after city return')
local source=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(expected.Source.X,expected.Source.Y))
assert(source:GetOwner()==1,'old AI Palace city not absorbed')
for _,key in ipairs({'GreatWorkType','ObjectType','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do
 assert(found[1][key]==expected.Source[key],'acquired original metadata changed: '..key)
end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(found[1].Effects,expected.Source.Effects),'acquired original effects changed')
assert(#tx.Cities>=1,'donor city inventory was empty')
for _,lost in ipairs(tx.Cities) do
 local absorbed=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(lost.X,lost.Y))
 assert(absorbed:GetOwner()==1,'donor city remained outside absorber')
end
local donor=Players[2]
if donor then assert(donor:GetCities():GetCount()==0,'donor AI retained a city') end
local record=assert(A.GetRoster(1)['native-work:2'])
assert(record.NativeCustody.Owner==1 and record.NativeCustody.City==found[1].CityID
 and record.NativeCustody.Building==found[1].Building and record.NativeCustody.Slot==found[1].Slot,
 'recipient roster disagrees with exact native work slot')
local destination=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(expected.Target.X,expected.Target.Y))
local prior=assert(destination:GetProperty(A.Rules.GOVERNANCE_KEY),'recipient governance property was erased')
assert(prior.ID=='native-product-return-probe' and prior.From==0 and prior.To==1,
 'recipient governance history changed during temporary city custody')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_PRODUCT_RESULT] index=2 city='..found[1].CityID..' route='..snap.Carrier.Route)
return 'previously traded Palace original moved through saved recipient-owned carrier'
